args.summary:
Modeled the cast-in-place prestressed concrete continuous box-girder bridge (30+45+30 m) as a 2D spine-beam model per MR-01/MR-05.

Structure: continuous_on_piers (pier column geometry given for Pier 1 and Pier 2). Single-cell cast_box girder, C55, integrated section A=7.05 m², I=4.777 m⁴, Ec=35500 MPa, γ=26 kN/m³ (JTG D60-2015 4.2.1), self-weight w=183.3 kN/m, m=18.685 t/m.

Supports: Abutments 0/3 and Pier 2 = PTFE sliding laminated elastomeric bearings (2 per line), vertical springs from JTG 3362-2018 8.7 (Ge=1.2 MPa manufacturer value): Kv=3.614e6 / 8.075e6 kN/m, Kh=0, longitudinally free. Pier 1 = spherical fixed pot bearings GPZ(II) 6000 GD (2 per line), vertical rigid and longitudinally fixed (MR-08). Piers modeled as elastic columns, base fixed: Pier 1 h=6 m, Pier 2 h=29 m, D=1.4 m twin columns merged (A=3.079 m², I=0.3771 m⁴, Ec=32500 MPa, C40).

Live load: Highway Class I, one-way, 3 design lanes (ξ=0.78), qk=10.5 kN/m, Pk=320/350/320 kN per span; impact factor μ=0.193 from f1=3.254 Hz (JTG D60-2015 4.3.2).

generate_model passed L1/L2/L3 checks. Results: first vertical frequencies 3.254/5.950/6.719 Hz; self-weight support reactions 1790.6, 7885.9, 7699.7, 1870.4 kN; self-weight mid-span moments 6237.6/18827.3/7434.4 kNm; lane max positive moment 11241.0 kNm and max negative moment −9143.5 kNm.
